description.value: Tim Hortons is a Canadian coffee-and-baked-goods chain located on Lakelse Avenue in downtown Terrace, a hub community along the Yellowhead Highway (BC-16) corridor in northwest BC. This location offers dine-in seating, takeout, and a drive-through, serving coffee, soups, wraps, and baked goods throughout the day. Free WiFi is available, making it a practical rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Terrace.
